message.content: {"note_claim": "Russia has about 1.1 million active-duty personnel, of which roughly 900,000 are deployed to Ukraine.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Russia is estimated to have a total of 1.1 million active-duty soldiers, roughly 600,000 of which are deployed in or near Ukraine.", "reason": "The page confirms the 1.1 million active-duty figure but gives roughly 600,000 deployed in or near Ukraine, not 900,000, and says nothing about NATO's troop presence."}

parsed.note_claim: Russia has about 1.1 million active-duty personnel, of which roughly 900,000 are deployed to Ukraine.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Russia is estimated to have a total of 1.1 million active-duty soldiers, roughly 600,000 of which are deployed in or near Ukraine.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the 1.1 million active-duty figure but gives roughly 600,000 deployed in or near Ukraine, not 900,000, and says nothing about NATO's troop presence.
